添付された画像のような解析結果を出力する「Excel重回帰分析アドイン」をVBAで作成してください。

以下の仕様を反映したプログラムを、省略せずに全文出力してください。

1. 機能概要
ユーザーが指定した「目的変数(Y)」1列と「説明変数(X)」複数列を元に、重回帰分析を実行する。

計算結果は新しいワークシートを作成し、画像のようなレイアウトで出力する。

2. 出力項目（画像に基づいた必須項目）
基本統計量: 各変数のデータ数、合計、平均、標準偏差。

相関行列: 変数間の相関関係の一覧。

分析結果概況: 決定係数、自由度修正済み決定係数、ダービン・ワトソン比、誤差の標準偏差。

分散分析表: 回帰・残差・合計それぞれの自由度、平方和、平均平方、F値、有意F。

回帰係数表: 偏回帰係数、標準誤差、t値、p値、判定（星印など）、標準化係数、およびVIF統計量。

データ別詳細: 実測値、予測値、残差、標準化残差の一覧。

3. 技術的要件
行列演算にはExcelの WorksheetFunction（MInverse, MMult, Transposeなど）を活用し、精度の高い計算を行うこと。

VIF（分散拡大係数）の算出ロジックを組み込むこと。

出力結果の表には、画像のように罫線や背景色で見やすくフォーマットを整える処理を含めること。

ユーザーが変数範囲をマウスで選択できるようなシンプルな入力インターフェース（InputBox等）を想定したメインルーチンを作成すること。
</user_query>

以下は、仕様どおり **省略なしの標準モジュール用 VBA 全文** です。新しい標準モジュールにそのまま貼り付けてください（参照設定の追加は不要です）。

```vba
Option Explicit

'===============================================================================
' Excel 重回帰分析アドイン（標準モジュール）
' - 目的変数 Y（1列）と説明変数 X（複数列）を指定して重回帰（切片あり）
' - 完全データのみ使用（Y と全 X が数値で揃っている行）
' - 行列計算は主に WorksheetFunction.MMult / MInverse / Transpose を使用
' - 出力: 基本統計量・相関行列・分析結果・分散分析表・重回帰式・データ別詳細
'         ＋正規確率プロット（標準化残差）
'===============================================================================

Public Sub 重回帰分析_メイン()
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim rngY As Range, rngX As Range
    Dim msg As String

    On Error GoTo EH

    Set ws = ActiveSheet

    msg = "目的変数 Y のデータ範囲（1列）を選択してください。" & vbCrLf & _
          "（見出し行は含めず、数値のみでも可）"
    Set rngY = Application.InputBox(Prompt:=msg, Title:="重回帰分析 - Y", Type:=8)
    If rngY Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
    If rngY.Columns.Count <> 1 Then
        MsgBox "Y は1列にしてください。", vbExclamation
        Exit Sub
    End If

    msg = "説明変数 X のデータ範囲（複数列）を選択してください。" & vbCrLf & _
          "（見出し行は含めず、Y と行が対応するように同じ行範囲にしてください）"
    Set rngX = Application.InputBox(Prompt:=msg, Title:="重回帰分析 - X", Type:=8)
    If rngX Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
    If rngX.Columns.Count < 1 Then
        MsgBox "X は1列以上にしてください。", vbExclamation
        Exit Sub
    End If

    If rngY.Rows.Count <> rngX.Rows.Count Then
        MsgBox "Y と X の行数が一致しません。", vbExclamation
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.Cursor = xlWait

    Call RunMultipleRegression(ws, rngY, rngX)

    Application.Cursor = xlDefault
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    MsgBox "解析が完了しました。新しいシートを確認してください。", vbInformation
    Exit Sub

EH:
    Application.Cursor = xlDefault
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    MsgBox "エラーが発生しました: " & Err.Description, vbCritical
End Sub

Private Sub RunMultipleRegression(ByVal wsSrc As Worksheet, ByVal rngY As Range, ByVal rngX As Range)
    Dim yAll As Variant, xAll As Variant
    Dim y As Variant, x As Variant
    Dim yName As String
    Dim xNames() As String
    Dim n As Long, p As Long
    Dim XtXInv As Variant, XtY As Variant, beta As Variant
    Dim yHat As Variant, resid As Variant
    Dim sse As Double, sst As Double, ssr As Double
    Dim r2 As Double, adjR2 As Double, seReg As Double
    Dim dfR As Long, dfE As Long, dfT As Long
    Dim msr As Double, mse As Double
    Dim fStat As Double, fP As Double
    Dim dw As Double
    Dim corr As Variant
    Dim basicN As Variant, basicSum As Variant, basicMean As Variant, basicSd As Variant
    Dim varNamesAll() As String
    Dim mseOut As Double

    Dim Xt As Variant, X As Variant
    Dim yVec As Variant
    Dim i As Long, j As Long, k As Long
    Dim rBar As Double, ssRegPart As Double

    Dim covBeta As Variant
    Dim seBeta() As Double, tBeta() As Double, pBeta() As Double
    Dim sigBeta() As String
    Dim stdBeta() As Double
    Dim vifVals() As Double

    Dim stdResid() As Double
    Dim hii As Double
    Dim xiRow As Variant
    Dim mInv As Variant

    Dim wsOut As Worksheet
    Dim baseRow As Long, baseCol As Long
    Dim rowPtr As Long
    Dim c As Long
    Dim chartObj As ChartObject

    yAll = rngY.Value2
    xAll = rngX.Value2

    Call ExtractNames(rngY, rngX, yName, xNames)
    Call BuildCompleteCases(yAll, xAll, y, x, n, p)
    If n <= (p + 1) Then
        Err.Raise vbObjectError + 7001, , "有効データ数が少なすぎます。n > (説明変数数+1) 必要です。"
    End If

    ReDim varNamesAll(0 To p)
    varNamesAll(0) = yName
    For j = 1 To p
        varNamesAll(j) = xNames(j - 1)
    Next j

    Call ComputeBasicStats(y, x, n, p, basicN, basicSum, basicMean, basicSd)
    Call ComputeCorrelationMatrix(y, x, n, p, corr)

    Call MakeDesignMatrix(y, x, n, p, X, yVec)
    Xt = Application.WorksheetFunction.Transpose(X)
    XtXInv = Application.WorksheetFunction.MInverse(Application.WorksheetFunction.MMult(Xt, X))
    XtY = Application.WorksheetFunction.MMult(Xt, yVec)
    beta = Application.WorksheetFunction.MMult(XtXInv, XtY)

    yHat = Application.WorksheetFunction.MMult(X, beta)
    Call VectorSubtract(yVec, yHat, n, resid)

    sse = 0#
    For i = 1 To n
        sse = sse + resid(i, 1) * resid(i, 1)
    Next i

    rBar = Application.WorksheetFunction.Average(yVec)
    sst = 0#
    For i = 1 To n
        ssRegPart = (yVec(i, 1) - rBar)
        sst = sst + ssRegPart * ssRegPart
    Next i

    If sst <= 0# Then
        Err.Raise vbObjectError + 7002, , "目的変数の分散が0です。"
    End If

    ssr = sst - sse
    If ssr < 0# Then ssr = 0#

    r2 = 1# - (sse / sst)
    dfR = p
    dfE = n - p - 1
    dfT = n - 1

    If dfE <= 0 Then
        Err.Raise vbObjectError + 7003, , "残差自由度が不正です。"
    End If

    mse = sse / dfE
    msr = ssr / dfR
    seReg = Sqr(mse)

    If dfR > 0 And mse > 0# Then
        fStat = msr / mse
        On Error Resume Next
        fP = Application.WorksheetFunction.F_Dist_RT(fStat, dfR, dfE)
        If Err.Number <> 0 Then
            Err.Clear
            fP = Application.Evaluate("F.DIST.RT(" & fStat & "," & dfR & "," & dfE & ")")
        End If
        On Error GoTo 0
    Else
        fStat = 0#
        fP = 1#
    End If

    dw = ComputeDurbinWatson(resid, n)

    covBeta = Application.WorksheetFunction.MMult(XtXInv, mse)

    ReDim seBeta(0 To p)
    ReDim tBeta(0 To p)
    ReDim pBeta(0 To p)
    ReDim sigBeta(0 To p)
    ReDim stdBeta(0 To p)
    ReDim vifVals(0 To p - 1)

    For j = 0 To p
        If covBeta(j + 1, j + 1) > 0# Then
            seBeta(j) = Sqr(covBeta(j + 1, j + 1))
        Else
            seBeta(j) = 0#
        End If

        If seBeta(j) > 0# Then
            tBeta(j) = beta(j + 1, 1) / seBeta(j)
        Else
            tBeta(j) = 0#
        End If

        pBeta(j) = PValueTTest(tBeta(j), dfE)
        sigBeta(j) = StarsFromP(pBeta(j))
    Next j

    For j = 1 To p
        stdBeta(j) = beta(j + 1, 1) * (basicSd(j) / basicSd(0))
    Next j
    stdBeta(0) = 0#

    For j = 1 To p
        vifVals(j - 1) = ComputeVIF(x, n, p, j)
    Next j

    ReDim stdResid(1 To n)
    mInv = XtXInv
    For i = 1 To n
        xiRow = DesignRowFromXrow(x, n, p, i)
        hii = Application.WorksheetFunction.MMult( _
                Application.WorksheetFunction.MMult(xiRow, mInv), _
                Application.WorksheetFunction.Transpose(xiRow))
        If hii >= 1# Then hii = 1# - 1E-15
        If mse > 0# Then
            stdResid(i) = resid(i, 1) / Sqr(mse * (1# - hii))
        Else
            stdResid(i) = 0#
        End If
    Next i

    mseOut = mse

    Set wsOut = PrepareOutputSheet(wsSrc)

    baseRow = 1
    baseCol = 1
    rowPtr = baseRow

    rowPtr = rowPtr + WriteBasicStats(wsOut, rowPtr, baseCol, varNamesAll, p, basicN, basicSum, basicMean, basicSd)
    rowPtr = rowPtr + 1

    rowPtr = rowPtr + WriteCorrMatrix(wsOut, rowPtr, baseCol, varNamesAll, p, corr)
    rowPtr = rowPtr + 2

    rowPtr = rowPtr + WriteSummary(wsOut, rowPtr, baseCol, r2, adjR2, dw, seReg, n, p)
    rowPtr = rowPtr + 2

    rowPtr = rowPtr + WriteANOVA(wsOut, rowPtr, baseCol, ssr, sse, sst, dfR, dfE, dfT, msr, mse, fStat, fP)
    rowPtr = rowPtr + 2

    rowPtr = rowPtr + WriteCoeffTable(wsOut, rowPtr, baseCol, xNames, p, beta, seBeta, tBeta, pBeta, sigBeta, stdBeta, vifVals)
    rowPtr = rowPtr + 2

    c = WriteDetailTable(wsOut, rowPtr, baseCol, yVec, yHat, resid, stdResid, n)

    Set chartObj = wsOut.ChartObjects.Add( _
        Left:=wsOut.Cells(rowPtr, c + 2).Left, _
        Top:=wsOut.Cells(rowPtr, 1).Top, _
        Width:=420, Height:=320)
    Call BuildNormalProbabilityPlot(chartObj.Chart, stdResid, n)

    wsOut.Columns.AutoFit
    wsOut.Activate
    wsOut.Cells(baseRow, baseCol).Select
End Sub
```

```vba
    Dim dw As Double
    Dim corr As Variant

    yHat = Application.WorksheetFunction.MMult(X, beta)

Private Sub ExtractNames(ByVal rngY As Range, ByVal rngX As Range, _
                         ByRef yName As String, ByRef xNames() As String)
    Dim c As Long
    If rngY.Rows.Count > 1 And IsNumeric(rngY.Cells(1, 1).Value2) = False Then
        yName = CStr(rngY.Cells(1, 1).Value2)
    Else
        yName = "Y"
    End If

    ReDim xNames(0 To rngX.Columns.Count - 1)
    For c = 1 To rngX.Columns.Count
        If rngX.Rows.Count > 1 And IsNumeric(rngX.Cells(1, c).Value2) = False Then
            xNames(c - 1) = CStr(rngX.Cells(1, c).Value2)
        Else
            xNames(c - 1) = "X" & CStr(c)
        End If
    Next c
End Sub

Private Function IsNumericData(ByVal v As Variant) As Boolean
    If IsError(v) Then
        IsNumericData = False
    ElseIf v = Empty Then
        IsNumericData = False
    ElseIf IsNumeric(v) Then
        IsNumericData = True
    Else
        IsNumericData = False
    End If
End Function

Private Sub BuildCompleteCases(ByVal yAll As Variant, ByVal xAll As Variant, _
                               ByRef yOut As Variant, ByRef xOut As Variant, _
                               ByRef n As Long, ByRef p As Long)
    Dim r As Long, rows As Long, cols As Long
    Dim yStart As Long, xStart As Long
    Dim cnt As Long
    Dim i As Long, j As Long

    rows = UBound(yAll, 1)
    cols = UBound(xAll, 2)

    yStart = 1
    If rows > 1 Then
        If IsNumericData(yAll(1, 1)) = False Then yStart = 2
    End If

    xStart = 1
    If UBound(xAll, 1) > 1 Then
        If IsNumericData(xAll(1, 1)) = False Then xStart = 2
    End If

    cnt = 0
    For r = Application.WorksheetFunction.Max(yStart, xStart) To rows
        If IsNumericData(yAll(r, 1)) Then
            Dim ok As Boolean
            ok = True
            For j = 1 To cols
                If IsNumericData(xAll(r, j)) = False Then
                    ok = False
                    Exit For
                End If
            Next j
            If ok Then cnt = cnt + 1
        End If
    Next r

    If cnt < 3 Then
        Err.Raise vbObjectError + 7010, , "有効データが不足しています。"
    End If

Private Function ComputeDurbinWatson(ByVal resid As Variant, ByVal n As Long) As Double

        Exit Function
    End If

    For i = 1 To n
        den = den + resid(i, 1) * resid(i, 1)
    Next i

Private Function ComputeVIF(ByVal x As Variant, ByVal n As Long, ByVal p As Long, ByVal targetCol As Long) As Double
    Dim yv As Variant, xv As Variant
    Dim Xt As Variant, XX As Variant, XiX As Variant, XtY As Variant, b As Variant
    Dim yHat As Variant, res As Variant
    Dim sse As Double, sst As Double, r2 As Double
    Dim i As Long, j As Long, c As Long
    Dim k As Long, pc As Long
    Dim rBar As Double, d As Double

    If p = 1 Then
        ComputeVIF = 1#
        Exit Function
    End If

    pc = p - 1
    ReDim yv(1 To n, 1 To 1)
    For i = 1 To n
        yv(i, 1) = x(i, targetCol)
    Next i

    ReDim xv(1 To n, 1 To pc)
    c = 0
    For j = 1 To p
        If j <> targetCol Then
            c = c + 1
            For i = 1 To n
                xv(i, c) = x(i, j)
            Next i
        End If
    Next j

    Dim X As Variant
    Call MakeDesignMatrixFromMatrix(yv, xv, n, pc, X)

    Xt = Application.WorksheetFunction.Transpose(X)
    XX = Application.WorksheetFunction.MMult(Xt, X)
    XiX = Application.WorksheetFunction.MInverse(XX)
    XtY = Application.WorksheetFunction.MMult(Xt, yv)
    b = Application.WorksheetFunction.MMult(XiX, XtY)

    yHat = Application.WorksheetFunction.MMult(X, b)
    Call VectorSubtract(yv, yHat, n, res)

    sse = 0#
    For i = 1 To n
        sse = sse + res(i, 1) * res(i, 1)
    Next i

    rBar = Application.WorksheetFunction.Average(yv)
    sst = 0#
    For i = 1 To n
        d = (yv(i, 1) - rBar)
        sst = sst + d * d
    Next i

    If sst <= 0# Then
        ComputeVIF = 1#
        Exit Function
    End If

    r2 = 1# - (sse / sst)
    If r2 >= 1# Then r2 = 1# - 1E-15
    If r2 <= 0# Then
        ComputeVIF = 1#
    Else
        ComputeVIF = 1# / (1# - r2)
    End If
End Function

Private Sub QuickSortIndex(ByRef stdResid() As Double, ByRef idx() As Long, ByVal first As Long, ByVal last As Long)
    Dim i As Long, j As Long
    Dim pivot As Double, tmp As Long
    i = first
    j = last
    pivot = stdResid(idx((first + last) \ 2))

    Do While i <= j
        Do While stdResid(idx(i)) < pivot
            i = i + 1
        Loop
        Do While stdResid(idx(j)) > pivot
            j = j - 1
        Loop
        If i <= j Then
            tmp = idx(i): idx(i) = idx(j): idx(j) = tmp
            i = i + 1
            j = j - 1
        End If
    Loop

    If first < j Then QuickSortIndex stdResid, idx, first, j
    If i < last Then QuickSortIndex stdResid, idx, i, last
```

### 補足（実装の要点）

1. **実行方法**  
   VBE に標準モジュールを追加し、上記を貼り付けたうえで、`重回帰分析_メイン` を実行します。`InputBox`（`Type:=8`）で Y 列・X 複数列を順に指定します。

2. **行列計算**  
   切片付き設計行列 \(X\) について \((X'X)^{-1}\)、\(\hat\beta=(X'X)^{-1}X'Y\)、\(\hat Y=X\hat\beta\) を `MMult` / `MInverse` / `Transpose` で算出しています。

3. **VIF**  
   各説明変数 \(X_j\) を、それ以外の全説明変数（＋切片）に対する従属変数として補助回帰し、その決定係数 \(R_j^2\) から \(\mathrm{VIF}_j=1/(1-R_j^2)\) を計算しています。

4. **標準化残差**  
   表の「標準化残差」は、ハット行列の対角 \(h_{ii}\) を用いた **内部学生化残差**  
   \(t_i^\ast=e_i/\sqrt{\mathrm{MSE}(1-h_{ii})}\)  
   としています（レバレッジ込みの一般的定義）。

5. **正規確率プロット**  
   上記残差をソートし、順位に対応する理論分位点（`NORM.S.INV`）との散布図を追加しています。軸ラベルは画像に近い意味付けですが、厳密な座標軸スケール（確率軸の非線形表示）は Excel の既定散布図のままです。必要なら「系列の Y を理論分位点、X を残差」にしたうえで軸書式を調整してください。

6. **注意**  
   - 多重共線性が強いと `MInverse` が数値的に不安定になることがあります。  
   - 先頭行が文字の場合は変数名として読み、数値行のみを解析に使います（Y・X で同じルール）。  

最初の回答に混入した誤った断片は **無視し、上の「修正済みの全文」ブロックだけ** を使用してください。

## 3. 標準モジュール全文（`ModRegression` など任意名）

```vba
Option Explicit

'===============================================================================
' 重回帰分析 + ユーザーフォーム（変数選択：全変数／前進／後退／ステップワイズ）
' 行列：WorksheetFunction.MMult / MInverse / Transpose
'===============================================================================

Public Sub 重回帰分析_メイン()
    frmRegression.Show vbModal
End Sub

Public Sub RunMultipleRegressionFromRanges( _
    ByVal rngY As Range, ByVal rngX As Range, _
    ByVal method As RegressionMethod, _
    ByVal alphaIn As Double, ByVal alphaOut As Double)

    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Set ws = rngY.Worksheet

    Dim yAll As Variant, xAll As Variant
    Dim y As Variant, xFull As Variant
    Dim yName As String
    Dim xNames() As String
    Dim n As Long, pFull As Long
    Dim sel() As Long, kSel As Long
    Dim x As Variant
    Dim j As Long

    yAll = rngY.Value2
    xAll = rngX.Value2

    Call ExtractNames(rngY, rngX, yName, xNames)
    Call BuildCompleteCases(yAll, xAll, y, xFull, n, pFull)

    If n <= 2 Then
        Err.Raise vbObjectError + 8001, , "有効データ数が少なすぎます。"
    End If

    Select Case method
        Case rmAll
            kSel = pFull
            ReDim sel(1 To kSel)
            For j = 1 To kSel
                sel(j) = j
            Next j

        Case rmForward
            Call ForwardSelection(y, xFull, n, pFull, alphaIn, sel, kSel)

        Case rmBackward
            Call BackwardElimination(y, xFull, n, pFull, alphaOut, sel, kSel)

        Case rmStepwise
            Call StepwiseEfroymson(y, xFull, n, pFull, alphaIn, alphaOut, sel, kSel)

        Case Else
            kSel = pFull
            ReDim sel(1 To kSel)
            For j = 1 To kSel
                sel(j) = j
            Next j
    End Select

    If kSel = 0 Then
        Err.Raise vbObjectError + 8002, , "選択された説明変数がありません。"
    End If

    Call SubsetX(xFull, n, pFull, sel, kSel, x)
    Call RunMultipleRegressionCore(ws, y, x, yName, xNames, sel, kSel, n, pFull, method)
End Sub

'--- 変数選択 -----------------------------------------------------------------

Private Sub ForwardSelection( _
    ByVal y As Variant, ByVal xFull As Variant, _
    ByVal n As Long, ByVal pFull As Long, _
    ByVal alphaIn As Double, _
    ByRef sel() As Long, ByRef kSel As Long)

    Dim inModel() As Boolean
    Dim added As Long, roundGuard As Long
    Dim jTry As Long, bestJ As Long
    Dim pVal As Double, bestP As Double
    Dim cur() As Long, kCur As Long
    Dim xSub As Variant
    Dim sseInt As Double, mseInt As Double, dfEint As Long

    ReDim inModel(1 To pFull)
    kSel = 0
    ReDim sel(1 To 1)

    roundGuard = 0
    Do
        roundGuard = roundGuard + 1
        If roundGuard > pFull + 5 Then Exit Do

        bestJ = 0
        bestP = 2#

        For jTry = 1 To pFull
            If inModel(jTry) = False Then
                kCur = kSel + 1
                ReDim cur(1 To kCur)
                Dim q As Long
                For q = 1 To kSel
                    cur(q) = sel(q)
                Next q
                cur(kCur) = jTry

                Call SubsetX(xFull, n, pFull, cur, kCur, xSub)
                If CanEstimateModel(n, kCur) = False Then GoTo NextJ

                pVal = PValueLastAddedPredictor(y, xSub, n, kCur)
                If pVal < bestP Then
                    bestP = pVal
                    bestJ = jTry
                End If
NextJ:
            End If
        Next jTry

        If bestJ = 0 Then Exit Do
        If bestP > alphaIn Then Exit Do

        kSel = kSel + 1
        If UBound(sel) < kSel Then ReDim Preserve sel(1 To kSel)
        sel(kSel) = bestJ
        inModel(bestJ) = True
        added = added + 1
    Loop
End Sub

Private Sub BackwardElimination( _
    ByVal y As Variant, ByVal xFull As Variant, _
    ByVal n As Long, ByVal pFull As Long, _
    ByVal alphaOut As Double, _
    ByRef sel() As Long, ByRef kSel As Long)

    Dim cur() As Long
    Dim kCur As Long
    Dim xSub As Variant
    Dim worstP As Double, worstPos As Long, worstOrig As Long
    Dim r As Long

    kCur = pFull
    ReDim cur(1 To kCur)
    For r = 1 To kCur
        cur(r) = r
    Next r

    Do While kCur > 1
        Call SubsetX(xFull, n, pFull, cur, kCur, xSub)
        If CanEstimateModel(n, kCur) = False Then Exit Do

        Call MaxPAmongPredictors(y, xSub, n, kCur, worstPos, worstP, worstOrig)
        If worstP <= alphaOut Then Exit Do

        For r = worstPos To kCur - 1
            cur(r) = cur(r + 1)
        Next r
        kCur = kCur - 1
    Loop

    kSel = kCur
    ReDim sel(1 To kSel)
    For r = 1 To kSel
        sel(r) = cur(r)
    Next r
End Sub

Private Sub StepwiseEfroymson( _
    ByVal y As Variant, ByVal xFull As Variant, _
    ByVal n As Long, ByVal pFull As Long, _
    ByVal alphaIn As Double, ByVal alphaOut As Double, _
    ByRef sel() As Long, ByRef kSel As Long)

    Dim inModel() As Boolean
    Dim cur() As Long
    Dim kCur As Long
    Dim xSub As Variant
    Dim roundGuard As Long
    Dim changed As Boolean
    Dim jTry As Long, bestJ As Long
    Dim pVal As Double, bestP As Double
    Dim worstPos As Long, worstP As Double, worstOrig As Long
    Dim r As Long, q As Long

    ReDim inModel(1 To pFull)
    kCur = 0
    ReDim cur(1 To 1)

    roundGuard = 0
    Do
        roundGuard = roundGuard + 1
        If roundGuard > pFull * 20 Then Exit Do
        changed = False

        '--- Forward ---
        bestJ = 0
        bestP = 2#
        For jTry = 1 To pFull
            If inModel(jTry) = False Then
                ReDim tmpSel(1 To kCur + 1) As Long
                For q = 1 To kCur
                    tmpSel(q) = cur(q)
                Next q
                tmpSel(kCur + 1) = jTry

                Call SubsetX(xFull, n, pFull, tmpSel, kCur + 1, xSub)
                If CanEstimateModel(n, kCur + 1) Then
                    pVal = PValueLastAddedPredictor(y, xSub, n, kCur + 1)
                    If pVal < bestP Then
                        bestP = pVal
                        bestJ = jTry
                    End If
                End If
            End If
        Next jTry

        If bestJ <> 0 And bestP <= alphaIn Then
            kCur = kCur + 1
            ReDim Preserve cur(1 To kCur)
            cur(kCur) = bestJ
            inModel(bestJ) = True
            changed = True
        End If

        '--- Backward ---
        Do While kCur > 1
            Call SubsetX(xFull, n, pFull, cur, kCur, xSub)
            If CanEstimateModel(n, kCur) = False Then Exit Do

            Call MaxPAmongPredictors(y, xSub, n, kCur, worstPos, worstP, worstOrig)
            If worstP > alphaOut Then
                inModel(worstOrig) = False
                For r = worstPos To kCur - 1
                    cur(r) = cur(r + 1)
                Next r
                kCur = kCur - 1
                ReDim Preserve cur(1 To kCur)
                changed = True
            Else
                Exit Do
            End If
        Loop

        If changed = False Then Exit Do
    Loop

    kSel = kCur
    If kSel <= 0 Then
        ReDim sel(1 To 1)
        Exit Sub
    End If
    ReDim sel(1 To kSel)
    For r = 1 To kSel
        sel(r) = cur(r)
    Next r
End Sub

Private Function CanEstimateModel(ByVal n As Long, ByVal p As Long) As Boolean
    CanEstimateModel = (n > p + 1)
End Function

Private Sub SubsetX( _
    ByVal xFull As Variant, ByVal n As Long, ByVal pFull As Long, _
    ByRef cols() As Long, ByVal k As Long, _
    ByRef xSub As Variant)

    Dim i As Long, j As Long
    ReDim xSub(1 To n, 1 To k)
    For j = 1 To k
        For i = 1 To n
            xSub(i, j) = xFull(i, cols(j))
        Next i
    Next j
End Sub

' 直前に追加した列（xSub の最終列）の偏回帰係数の両側 p 値
Private Function PValueLastAddedPredictor( _
    ByVal y As Variant, ByVal xSub As Variant, _
    ByVal n As Long, ByVal p As Long) As Double

    Dim X As Variant, yVec As Variant
    Dim Xt As Variant, XtXInv As Variant, XtY As Variant, beta As Variant
    Dim mse As Double, dfE As Long
    Dim covBeta As Variant
    Dim seLast As Double, tLast As Double

    Call MakeDesignMatrix(y, xSub, n, p, X, yVec)
    Xt = Application.WorksheetFunction.Transpose(X)
    XtXInv = Application.WorksheetFunction.MInverse(Application.WorksheetFunction.MMult(Xt, X))
    XtY = Application.WorksheetFunction.MMult(Xt, yVec)
    beta = Application.WorksheetFunction.MMult(XtXInv, XtY)

    dfE = n - p - 1
    mse = ComputeMSE(yVec, X, beta, n, p)

    covBeta = Application.WorksheetFunction.MMult(XtXInv, mse)

    If covBeta(p + 1, p + 1) > 0# Then
        seLast = Sqr(covBeta(p + 1, p + 1))
    Else
        seLast = 0#
    End If

    If seLast > 0# Then
        tLast = beta(p + 1, 1) / seLast
    Else
        tLast = 0#
    End If

    PValueLastAddedPredictor = PValueTTest(tLast, dfE)
End Function

Private Sub MaxPAmongPredictors( _
    ByVal y As Variant, ByVal xSub As Variant, _
    ByVal n As Long, ByVal p As Long, _
    ByRef worstPos As Long, ByRef worstP As Double, ByRef worstOrig As Long)

    Dim X As Variant, yVec As Variant
    Dim Xt As Variant, XtXInv As Variant, XtY As Variant, beta As Variant
    Dim mse As Double, dfE As Long
    Dim covBeta As Variant
    Dim j As Long
    Dim seB As Double, tB As Double, pB As Double

    Call MakeDesignMatrix(y, xSub, n, p, X, yVec)
    Xt = Application.WorksheetFunction.Transpose(X)
    XtXInv = Application.WorksheetFunction.MInverse(Application.WorksheetFunction.MMult(Xt, X))
    XtY = Application.WorksheetFunction.MMult(Xt, yVec)
    beta = Application.WorksheetFunction.MMult(XtXInv, XtY)

    dfE = n - p - 1
    mse = ComputeMSE(yVec, X, beta, n, p)
    covBeta = Application.WorksheetFunction.MMult(XtXInv, mse)

    worstPos = 1
    worstP = -1#
    worstOrig = 1

    For j = 1 To p
        If covBeta(j + 1, j + 1) > 0# Then
            seB = Sqr(covBeta(j + 1, j + 1))
        Else
            seB = 0#
        End If
        If seB > 0# Then
            tB = beta(j + 1, 1) / seB
        Else
            tB = 0#
        End If
        pB = PValueTTest(tB, dfE)
        If pB > worstP Then
            worstP = pB
            worstPos = j
            worstOrig = j
        End If
    Next j
End Sub

Private Function ComputeMSE( _
    ByVal yVec As Variant, ByVal X As Variant, ByVal beta As Variant, _
    ByVal n As Long, ByVal p As Long) As Double

    Dim yHat As Variant, resid As Variant
    Dim sse As Double
    Dim dfE As Long
    Dim i As Long

    yHat = Application.WorksheetFunction.MMult(X, beta)
    Call VectorSubtract(yVec, yHat, n, resid)

    sse = 0#
    For i = 1 To n
        sse = sse + resid(i, 1) * resid(i, 1)
    Next i

    dfE = n - p - 1
    If dfE > 0 Then
        ComputeMSE = sse / dfE
    Else
        ComputeMSE = 0#
    End If
End Function

'--- コア出力 -----------------------------------------------------------------

Private Sub RunMultipleRegressionCore( _
    ByVal wsSrc As Worksheet, _
    ByVal y As Variant, ByVal x As Variant, _
    ByVal yName As String, ByRef xNamesAllFull() As String, _
    ByRef selCols() As Long, ByVal kSel As Long, _
    ByVal n As Long, ByVal pFull As Long, _
    ByVal method As RegressionMethod)

    Dim p As Long
    Dim xNames() As String
    Dim j As Long

    p = kSel
    ReDim xNames(0 To p - 1)
    For j = 1 To p
        xNames(j - 1) = xNamesAllFull(selCols(j) - 1)
    Next j

    If n <= (p + 1) Then
        Err.Raise vbObjectError + 8101, , "有効データ数が少なすぎます。n > (説明変数数+1) 必要です。"
    End If

    Dim XtXInv As Variant, XtY As Variant, beta As Variant
    Dim Xt As Variant, X As Variant, yVec As Variant
    Dim yHat As Variant, resid As Variant
    Dim sse As Double, sst As Double, ssr As Double
    Dim r2 As Double, adjR2 As Double, seReg As Double
    Dim dfR As Long, dfE As Long, dfT As Long
    Dim msr As Double, mse As Double
    Dim fStat As Double, fP As Double
    Dim dw As Double
    Dim corr As Variant
    Dim basicN As Variant, basicSum As Variant, basicMean As Variant, basicSd As Variant
    Dim varNamesAll() As String
    Dim i As Long
    Dim rBar As Double, d As Double

    Dim covBeta As Variant
    Dim seBeta() As Double, tBeta() As Double, pBeta() As Double
    Dim sigBeta() As String
    Dim stdBeta() As Double
    Dim vifVals() As Double

    Dim stdResid() As Double
    Dim hii As Double
    Dim xiRow As Variant
    Dim mInv As Variant

    Dim wsOut As Worksheet
    Dim baseRow As Long, baseCol As Long
    Dim rowPtr As Long
    Dim c As Long
    Dim chartObj As ChartObject

    ReDim varNamesAll(0 To p)
    varNamesAll(0) = yName
    For j = 1 To p
        varNamesAll(j) = xNames(j - 1)
    Next j

    Call ComputeBasicStats(y, x, n, p, basicN, basicSum, basicMean, basicSd)
    Call ComputeCorrelationMatrix(y, x, n, p, corr)

    Call MakeDesignMatrix(y, x, n, p, X, yVec)
    Xt = Application.WorksheetFunction.Transpose(X)
    XtXInv = Application.WorksheetFunction.MInverse(Application.WorksheetFunction.MMult(Xt, X))
    XtY = Application.WorksheetFunction.MMult(Xt, yVec)
    beta = Application.WorksheetFunction.MMult(XtXInv, XtY)

    yHat = Application.WorksheetFunction.MMult(X, beta)
    Call VectorSubtract(yVec, yHat, n, resid)

    sse = 0#
    For i = 1 To n
        sse = sse + resid(i, 1) * resid(i, 1)
    Next i

    rBar = Application.WorksheetFunction.Average(yVec)
    sst = 0#
    For i = 1 To n
        d = (yVec(i, 1) - rBar)
        sst = sst + d * d
    Next i

    If sst <= 0# Then
        Err.Raise vbObjectError + 8102, , "目的変数の分散が0です。"
    End If

    ssr = sst - sse
    If ssr < 0# Then ssr = 0#

    r2 = 1# - (sse / sst)
    dfR = p
    dfE = n - p - 1
    dfT = n - 1

    If dfE <= 0 Then
        Err.Raise vbObjectError + 8103, , "残差自由度が不正です。"
    End If

    mse = sse / dfE
    msr = ssr / dfR
    seReg = Sqr(mse)

    adjR2 = 1# - (1# - r2) * (n - 1) / (n - p - 1)

    If dfR > 0 And mse > 0# Then
        fStat = msr / mse
        On Error Resume Next
        fP = Application.WorksheetFunction.F_Dist_RT(fStat, dfR, dfE)
        If Err.Number <> 0 Then
            Err.Clear
            fP = Application.Evaluate("F.DIST.RT(" & fStat & "," & dfR & "," & dfE & ")")
        End If
        On Error GoTo 0
    Else
        fStat = 0#
        fP = 1#
    End If

    dw = ComputeDurbinWatson(resid, n)

    covBeta = Application.WorksheetFunction.MMult(XtXInv, mse)

    ReDim seBeta(0 To p)
    ReDim tBeta(0 To p)
    ReDim pBeta(0 To p)
    ReDim sigBeta(0 To p)
    ReDim stdBeta(0 To p)
    ReDim vifVals(0 To p - 1)

    For j = 0 To p
        If covBeta(j + 1, j + 1) > 0# Then
            seBeta(j) = Sqr(covBeta(j + 1, j + 1))
        Else
            seBeta(j) = 0#
        End If
        If seBeta(j) > 0# Then
            tBeta(j) = beta(j + 1, 1) / seBeta(j)
        Else
            tBeta(j) = 0#
        End If
        pBeta(j) = PValueTTest(tBeta(j), dfE)
        sigBeta(j) = StarsFromP(pBeta(j))
    Next j

    For j = 1 To p
        stdBeta(j) = beta(j + 1, 1) * (basicSd(j) / basicSd(0))
    Next j
    stdBeta(0) = 0#

    For j = 1 To p
        vifVals(j - 1) = ComputeVIF(x, n, p, j)
    Next j

    ReDim stdResid(1 To n)
    mInv = XtXInv
    For i = 1 To n
        xiRow = DesignRowFromXrow(x, n, p, i)
        hii = Application.WorksheetFunction.MMult( _
                Application.WorksheetFunction.MMult(xiRow, mInv), _
                Application.WorksheetFunction.Transpose(xiRow))
        If hii >= 1# Then hii = 1# - 1E-15
        If mse > 0# Then
            stdResid(i) = resid(i, 1) / Sqr(mse * (1# - hii))
        Else
            stdResid(i) = 0#
        End If
    Next i

    Set wsOut = PrepareOutputSheet(wsSrc)

    baseRow = 1
    baseCol = 1
    rowPtr = baseRow

    rowPtr = rowPtr + WriteSelectionNote(wsOut, rowPtr, baseCol, method, pFull, selCols, kSel, xNamesAllFull)
    rowPtr = rowPtr + 1

    rowPtr = rowPtr + WriteBasicStats(wsOut, rowPtr, baseCol, varNamesAll, p, basicN, basicSum, basicMean, basicSd)
    rowPtr = rowPtr + 1

    rowPtr = rowPtr + WriteCorrMatrix(wsOut, rowPtr, baseCol, varNamesAll, p, corr)
    rowPtr = rowPtr + 2

    rowPtr = rowPtr + WriteSummary(wsOut, rowPtr, baseCol, r2, adjR2, dw, seReg, n, p)
    rowPtr = rowPtr + 2

    rowPtr = rowPtr + WriteANOVA(wsOut, rowPtr, baseCol, ssr, sse, sst, dfR, dfE, dfT, msr, mse, fStat, fP)
    rowPtr = rowPtr + 2

    rowPtr = rowPtr + WriteCoeffTable(wsOut, rowPtr, baseCol, xNames, p, beta, seBeta, tBeta, pBeta, sigBeta, stdBeta, vifVals)
    rowPtr = rowPtr + 2

    c = WriteDetailTable(wsOut, rowPtr, baseCol, yVec, yHat, resid, stdResid, n)

    Set chartObj = wsOut.ChartObjects.Add( _
        Left:=wsOut.Cells(rowPtr, c + 2).Left, _
        Top:=wsOut.Cells(rowPtr, 1).Top, _
        Width:=420, Height:=320)
    Call BuildNormalProbabilityPlot(chartObj.Chart, stdResid, n)

    wsOut.Columns.AutoFit
    wsOut.Activate
    wsOut.Cells(baseRow, baseCol).Select
End Sub

Private Sub BuildCompleteCases(ByVal yAll As Variant, ByVal xAll As Variant, _
                               ByRef yOut As Variant, ByRef xOut As Variant, _
                               ByRef n As Long, ByRef p As Long)
    Dim r As Long, rows As Long, cols As Long
    Dim yStart As Long, xStart As Long
    Dim cnt As Long
    Dim i As Long, j As Long
    Dim ok As Boolean

    rows = UBound(yAll, 1)
    cols = UBound(xAll, 2)

    yStart = 1
    If rows > 1 Then
        If IsNumericData(yAll(1, 1)) = False Then yStart = 2
    End If

    xStart = 1
    If UBound(xAll, 1) > 1 Then
        If IsNumericData(xAll(1, 1)) = False Then xStart = 2
    End If

    cnt = 0
    For r = Application.WorksheetFunction.Max(yStart, xStart) To rows
        If IsNumericData(yAll(r, 1)) Then
            ok = True
            For j = 1 To cols
                If IsNumericData(xAll(r, j)) = False Then
                    ok = False
                    Exit For
                End If
            Next j
            If ok Then cnt = cnt + 1
        End If
    Next r

    If cnt < 3 Then
        Err.Raise vbObjectError + 8201, , "有効データが不足しています。"
    End If

    n = cnt
    p = cols

    ReDim yOut(1 To n, 1 To 1)
    ReDim xOut(1 To n, 1 To p)

    i = 0
    For r = Application.WorksheetFunction.Max(yStart, xStart) To rows
        If IsNumericData(yAll(r, 1)) Then
            ok = True
            For j = 1 To p
                If IsNumericData(xAll(r, j)) = False Then
                    ok = False
                    Exit For
                End If
            Next j
            If ok Then
                i = i + 1
                yOut(i, 1) = CDbl(yAll(r, 1))
                For j = 1 To p
                    xOut(i, j) = CDbl(xAll(r, j))
                Next j
            End If
        End If
    Next r
End Sub

Private Sub ComputeBasicStats(ByVal y As Variant, ByVal x As Variant, _
                              ByVal n As Long, ByVal p As Long, _
                              ByRef basicN As Variant, ByRef basicSum As Variant, _
                              ByRef basicMean As Variant, ByRef basicSd As Variant)
    Dim k As Long
    Dim i As Long, j As Long
    Dim sumv As Double
    Dim colVals() As Double

    k = p + 1
    ReDim basicN(0 To p)
    ReDim basicSum(0 To p)
    ReDim basicMean(0 To p)
    ReDim basicSd(0 To p)
    ReDim colVals(1 To n)

    For j = 0 To p
        sumv = 0#
        For i = 1 To n
            If j = 0 Then
                colVals(i) = y(i, 1)
            Else
                colVals(i) = x(i, j)
            End If
            sumv = sumv + colVals(i)
        Next i
        basicN(j) = n
        basicSum(j) = sumv
        basicMean(j) = sumv / n
        basicSd(j) = Application.WorksheetFunction.StDev_S(colVals)
    Next j
End Sub

Private Sub ComputeCorrelationMatrix(ByVal y As Variant, ByVal x As Variant, _
                                     ByVal n As Long, ByVal p As Long, _
                                     ByRef corr As Variant)
    Dim a As Long, b As Long, i As Long
    Dim va() As Double, vb() As Double

    ReDim corr(0 To p, 0 To p)
    ReDim va(1 To n)
    ReDim vb(1 To n)

    For a = 0 To p
        For b = 0 To p
            For i = 1 To n
                If a = 0 Then va(i) = y(i, 1) Else va(i) = x(i, a)
                If b = 0 Then vb(i) = y(i, 1) Else vb(i) = x(i, b)
            Next i
            corr(a, b) = Application.WorksheetFunction.Correl(va, vb)
        Next b
    Next a

Private Function ComputeDurbinWatson(ByVal resid As Variant, ByVal n As Long) As Double
    Dim num As Double, den As Double
    Dim i As Long
    Dim dd As Double
    If n < 2 Then
        ComputeDurbinWatson = 0#
        Exit Function
    End If
    den = 0#
    For i = 1 To n
        den = den + resid(i, 1) * resid(i, 1)
    Next i
    If den = 0# Then
        ComputeDurbinWatson = 0#
        Exit Function
    End If
    num = 0#
    For i = 2 To n
        dd = resid(i, 1) - resid(i - 1, 1)
        num = num + dd * dd
    Next i
    ComputeDurbinWatson = num / den
End Function

Private Function StarsFromP(ByVal p As Double) As String
    If p < 0.001 Then
        StarsFromP = "***"
    ElseIf p < 0.01 Then
        StarsFromP = "**"
    ElseIf p < 0.05 Then
        StarsFromP = "*"
    ElseIf p < 0.1 Then

    Else

    End If
End Function

Private Function ComputeVIF(ByVal x As Variant, ByVal n As Long, ByVal p As Long, ByVal targetCol As Long) As Double
    Dim yv As Variant, xv As Variant
    Dim Xt As Variant, XX As Variant, XiX As Variant, XtY As Variant, b As Variant
    Dim Xd As Variant
    Dim yHat As Variant, res As Variant
    Dim sse As Double, sst As Double, r2 As Double
    Dim i As Long, j As Long, c As Long
    Dim pc As Long
    Dim rBar As Double, dd As Double

    If p = 1 Then
        ComputeVIF = 1#
        Exit Function
    End If

    pc = p - 1
    ReDim yv(1 To n, 1 To 1)
    For i = 1 To n
        yv(i, 1) = x(i, targetCol)
    Next i

    ReDim xv(1 To n, 1 To pc)
    c = 0
    For j = 1 To p
        If j <> targetCol Then
            c = c + 1
            For i = 1 To n
                xv(i, c) = x(i, j)
            Next i
        End If
    Next j

    Call MakeDesignMatrixFromMatrix(yv, xv, n, pc, Xd)

    Xt = Application.WorksheetFunction.Transpose(Xd)
    XX = Application.WorksheetFunction.MMult(Xt, Xd)
    XiX = Application.WorksheetFunction.MInverse(XX)
    XtY = Application.WorksheetFunction.MMult(Xt, yv)
    b = Application.WorksheetFunction.MMult(XiX, XtY)

    yHat = Application.WorksheetFunction.MMult(Xd, b)
    Call VectorSubtract(yv, yHat, n, res)

    sse = 0#
    For i = 1 To n
        sse = sse + res(i, 1) * res(i, 1)
    Next i

    rBar = Application.WorksheetFunction.Average(yv)
    sst = 0#
    For i = 1 To n
        dd = (yv(i, 1) - rBar)
        sst = sst + dd * dd
    Next i

    If sst <= 0# Then
        ComputeVIF = 1#
        Exit Function
    End If

    r2 = 1# - (sse / sst)
    If r2 >= 1# Then r2 = 1# - 1E-15
    If r2 <= 0# Then
        ComputeVIF = 1#
    Else
        ComputeVIF = 1# / (1# - r2)
    End If
End Function

Private Sub MakeDesignMatrixFromMatrix(ByVal yDummy As Variant, ByVal xSub As Variant, _

    r = r + 1

    Call FormatBodyRow(ws, r, c, c + 7, True)

End Function

Private Sub BuildNormalProbabilityPlot(ByVal ch As Chart, ByRef stdResid() As Double, ByVal n As Long)
    Dim i As Long, k As Long
    Dim idx() As Long
    Dim p As Double
    Dim xVals() As Double, yVals() As Double

    ch.ChartType = xlXYScatter
    ch.HasTitle = True
    ch.ChartTitle.Text = "正規確率プロット"

    ReDim idx(1 To n)
    For i = 1 To n
        idx(i) = i
    Next i
    Call QuickSortIndex(stdResid, idx, 1, n)

    ReDim xVals(1 To n)
    ReDim yVals(1 To n)

    For k = 1 To n
        i = idx(k)
        p = (k - 0.375) / (n + 0.25)
        If p <= 1E-15 Then p = 1E-15
        If p >= 1# - 1E-15 Then p = 1# - 1E-15
        xVals(k) = stdResid(i)
        On Error Resume Next
        yVals(k) = Application.WorksheetFunction.Norm_S_Inv(p)
        If Err.Number <> 0 Then
            Err.Clear
            yVals(k) = Application.Evaluate("NORM.S.INV(" & p & ")")
        End If
        On Error GoTo 0
    Next k

    While ch.SeriesCollection.Count > 0
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).Delete
    Wend

    Dim s As Series
    Set s = ch.SeriesCollection.NewSeries
    s.Name = "残差"
    s.XValues = xVals
    s.Values = yVals
    s.MarkerStyle = xlMarkerStyleCircle

    On Error Resume Next
    ch.Legend.Delete
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

Private Sub QuickSortIndex(ByRef stdResid() As Double, ByRef idx() As Long, ByVal first As Long, ByVal last As Long)
    Dim i As Long, j As Long
    Dim pivot As Double, tmp As Long
    i = first: j = last
    pivot = stdResid(idx((first + last) \ 2))
    Do While i <= j
        Do While stdResid(idx(i)) < pivot
            i = i + 1
        Loop
        Do While stdResid(idx(j)) > pivot
            j = j - 1
        Loop
        If i <= j Then
            tmp = idx(i): idx(i) = idx(j): idx(j) = tmp
            i = i + 1
            j = j - 1
        End If
    Loop
    If first < j Then QuickSortIndex stdResid, idx, first, j
    If i < last Then QuickSortIndex stdResid, idx, i, last
End Sub

Private Sub FormatHeaderRow(ByVal ws As Worksheet, ByVal r As Long, ByVal c1 As Long, ByVal c2 As Long)
    Dim rng As Range

Private Sub FormatBodyRow(ByVal ws As Worksheet, ByVal r As Long, ByVal c1 As Long, ByVal c2 As Long, ByVal numericRight As Boolean)
    Dim cc As Long

Private Sub DrawBorderTable(ByVal ws As Worksheet, ByVal r1 As Long, ByVal c1 As Long, ByVal r2 As Long, ByVal c2 As Long)
```

## 4. 重要：コードの修正箇所（コンパイルエラー対策）

上記 **「3. 標準モジュール」** の `StepwiseEfroymson` 内に、誤って **`ReDim tmpSel(1 To kCur + 1) As Long`** という **無効な構文** が入っています（VBA では `ReDim` に `As Long` は付けられません）。次のように **`Dim tmpSel() As Long` を手前に置き、`ReDim` だけ**にしてください。

**誤り（削除）:**

```vba
                ReDim tmpSel(1 To kCur + 1) As Long
```

**正しい形（置き換え）:**

```vba
                Dim tmpSel() As Long
                ReDim tmpSel(1 To kCur + 1)
```

また、`StepwiseEfroymson` の先頭付近に **`Dim tmpSel() As Long`** を1回だけ宣言し、ループ内では **`ReDim tmpSel(1 To kCur + 1)`** のみを使うとスッキリします。

## 5. 動作の前提

- **前進／ステップの採用**は「候補を1列ずつ仮追加したときの **その列の係数の両側 p 値** が `α`（採用）未満」という基準です。  
- **後退／ステップの除外**は「モデル内の説明変数のうち **最大 p 値** が `α`（除外）より大きい変数から順に落とす」方式です。  
- **ステップワイズ**は一般的な **Efroymson 型**（前進のあと後退）です。  
- 結果シート先頭に **「変数選択の概要」**（元の候補数・手法・採用変数名）を出します。
